import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pl = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana", "Eve"],
    "spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 999, 2000],
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pl)

# Add tier column using conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Display result
print(nw.to_native(df))
